emails.subject: [PT-123] Follow-Up: Outstanding Essential Documents for TMF - Site 101
emails.body:
Hi Sandra,

Hope you are having a good week.

I am writing to follow up on the outstanding essential documents for the new sub-investigators added to the study. As per our TMF review, we are still pending the following for Site 101:

- Dr. Emily Carter: Updated Medical License
- Dr. Frank Wright: Signed Financial Disclosure Form (FDF)

Could you please provide these documents at your earliest convenience so we can ensure our Trial Master File is up to date and inspection-ready?

Thank you for your assistance.

Best regards,

John Miller
Clinical Research Associate
Pharmatech Inc.

emails.subject: Re: [PT-123] Follow-Up: Outstanding Essential Documents for TMF - Site 101
emails.body:
Hi John,

Thanks for the reminder. Apologies for the delay.

I have just followed up with both Dr. Carter and Dr. Wright. I expect to have both documents collected and sent over to you by the end of this week.

I will keep you posted.

Best,

Sandra Chen
Clinical Research Coordinator
University Hospital
